title: Research: source-bound weighted diagonal rank-batching screen
body:
## Result

The selected complex profile spends most of its rank mass in children of ranks 1–5. This package tests a variable-rank diagonal-batching schedule on the pinned gauge44 local program. In both orientations it groups 5,520 of 5,522 climb-rank units into 256 children of summed rank at most 51, preserving the total local mass of 5,586. The retained independent local checker accepts the reordered unfused climbs, and the exact heterogeneous block-diagonal identity is checked separately.

At the target primitive saving `a=1/9`, the optimistic complex moment is 0.999493269793590 if a changed endpoint leaves six unpaid coordinates per family and retains centre mass 64. Five unpaid coordinates still give 1.013748787493345. The exact local ceiling bracket maps to κ between 0.10055765 and 0.10063855 under the retained planning conversion.

## Limits

This does not construct the six-unpaid dirty-input endpoint, price physical fusion, or improve the separate bit supplier. The model tolerates only six extra rank-one-equivalent units per call (seven fails) under an idle-displacing convention, for all gathering, frames, hosting, precision, delivery and restoration. The selected result remains unchanged; this is a local candidate screen, not a κ claim.

The registered replay passes on Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-weighted-diagonal-rank51
```

## Refreshed base and overlap

The PR head is rebased on canonical `main` at `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`. The package preserves its original task/source pins at `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`; the package check and full replay both pass on the refreshed base. Current main also contains [the κ=0.1 target screen](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/kappa01-target-screen) and [the rank-cap floor](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/kappa010-rank-cap-floor). Those bound the selected profile and aggregate coverage law; this package changes the local rank histogram but still lacks a realizable six-unpaid endpoint and complete interface bill. Main also contains a [scoped P112 six-mode floor](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/p112-six-mode-exclusion) reporting cost at least 297 for its fixed aligned PR2757 family, above the necessary C <= 296 gate. I ran both registered Python 3.12 implementations (`verify.py` and `independent.py`); they each pass with minimum 297 over 5,440 term-count cases. Changed covers and mode assignments remain outside the stated scope, so this blocks that particular aligned endpoint route rather than every six-unpaid contract. A separate current-main [complex lever screen](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/kappa010-complex-lever-floor) reports a d=3 paired-plane moment of 0.995605 at `a=1/9` with the centre retained; I reran its registered Python 3.12 verifier and it passes. It still lacks a source-bound native block and a bit-side improvement, and no composition with this batch schedule is claimed.

A focused overlap refresh on 2026-10-17 03:02 UTC covered all 243 open PRs and 1,874 discussions with complete pagination. The exact-mechanism query surfaced this PR and a #1166 handoff comment about earlier gauge44 rank-2 retiming; no second exact open-PR match appeared under those terms. The package README records the close prior batching work and the limits of this overlap check.
